fields.description: One of the names in sketch/events.py. Data and not Select, so a new event needs no doctype change.
fields.label: Event

fields.description: Who acted. Empty when the request never authenticated, which is what an auth_failed row is.
fields.label: User

fields.description: The Prototype hash id. Data and not Link: a deleted Prototype must not take its history with it, and must not block the delete.
fields.label: Prototype

fields.description: The one discriminator for this event: the tool name, the error key, or the check status.
fields.label: Detail

fields.description: How long the work took, in milliseconds. Zero when the event measures nothing.
fields.label: Ms
